title: KRX Resonance
excerpt: A restrained identity rebuilt as a kinetic signal system with orbiting type, spectral grids, and luminous depth.
description: KRX Resonance reframed the studio brand as a modular frequency field. The visual language combined quiet editorial typography with atmospheric motion layers designed for web launches, keynote loops, and social teasers.

process.title: Signal language
process.body: The logotype was deconstructed into orbital vectors and stacked back into a system that could behave consistently across static and animated formats.

process.title: Depth composition
process.body: Type blocks and data lines were organized in atmospheric layers so even flat applications carried a cinematic sense of distance.

process.title: Motion restraint
process.body: Animation timing stayed slow and deliberate, prioritizing a premium cadence over aggressive transitions.

title: Mula Atlas
excerpt: A packaging concept where luminous topographic lines, mineral tones, and translucent materials turn the container into a gallery object.
description: Mula Atlas explored packaging as a collectible artifact. The system used layered linework, restrained serif titles, and soft blue reflections to bring a premium ritual feel to product interaction.

process.title: Material first
process.body: The design language began with reflections, thickness, and translucency before typography was introduced.

process.title: Atlas graphics
process.body: Contour lines were drawn as a generative field and manually curated to feel elegant rather than purely technical.

process.title: Shelf presence
process.body: The final system was tuned to read from distance without losing the close-up detail that makes premium packaging rewarding.

title: Aether Posters
excerpt: An experimental poster collection blending scanline shaders, fractured grids, and responsive typography for cultural programming.
description: Aether Posters became a sandbox for building expressive type compositions that feel both computational and tactile. The outputs stretched across prints, motion studies, and immersive launch visuals.

process.title: Typographic choreography
process.body: Letterforms were treated as bodies in motion, stretched and displaced through wave fields until each poster carried a sense of pressure and release.

process.title: Shader framing
process.body: Subtle scanlines and glow passes kept the visuals digital, but not sterile, adding atmosphere without obscuring the information.

process.title: Series logic
process.body: Each composition was generated from the same ruleset so the collection felt connected even when the outputs varied drastically.

title: North Core
excerpt: A bold monogram system extended across rigid packaging, dimensional signage, and restrained motion cues.
description: North Core translated a minimal identity into a compact launch system with high contrast geometry, beveled packaging, and graphic pacing designed for premium retail reveals.

process.title: Monolithic geometry
process.body: The identity leaned on beveled forms and condensed wordmarks so the work could feel architectural across print, motion, and packaging.

process.title: Launch container
process.body: Rigid box graphics were tuned to reveal themselves slowly through light, shadow, and edge contrast rather than loud ornament.

process.title: System expansion
process.body: The final toolkit extended from hero packaging into signage, digital key visuals, and motion lockups.

title: Framewear Drop
excerpt: A capsule release staged through kinetic apparel graphics, launch teasers, and tactile social loops.
description: Framewear Drop fused fashion graphics with social storytelling. The release system balanced oversized typography, garment visuals, and motion fragments designed for fast-moving launch sequences.

process.title: Graphic silhouette
process.body: The apparel itself became the hero object, with layouts shaped to read clearly on fabric, in motion, and inside short-form social crops.

process.title: Campaign rhythm
process.body: Posts, motion teasers, and lookbook fragments shared one timing system so the drop felt unified across touchpoints.

process.title: Digital texture
process.body: Soft grain and overprint-inspired tones kept the campaign tactile even when viewed on high-brightness screens.

title: Lucid Launch
excerpt: A motion-led identity system stretched across teaser frames, event loops, and modular announcement graphics.
description: Lucid Launch was conceived as a living broadcast package. Gradient light, modular framing, and paced typography allowed the system to shift from posters to trailers without losing coherence.

process.title: Moving frames
process.body: Layout blocks were designed to hold motion first, then tuned so still frames could inherit the same sense of energy and suspension.

process.title: Spectral accents
process.body: The identity used narrow bands of color and light as timing markers across intros, posters, and environmental displays.

process.title: Cross-format continuity
process.body: Every asset was built from the same modular framing rules to keep the campaign coherent at multiple scales.

title: Pulse Social
excerpt: A mobile-first campaign language combining bold type, modular cards, and luminous feeds for product storytelling.
description: Pulse Social turned a content-heavy launch into a precise mobile system. Motion cards, stacked layouts, and reactive color fields helped information move with clarity across social channels.

process.title: Mobile hierarchy
process.body: The layout system was built around thumb-friendly rhythm, vertical storytelling, and instant visual hierarchy.

process.title: Feed logic
process.body: Cards, crops, and color fields were designed to interlock when viewed as a sequence rather than isolated posts.

process.title: Momentum
process.body: Motion timing emphasized cadence and anticipation so the launch felt authored instead of templated.
